    (COUNT(DISTINCT superhero.id) * 100) / 
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT superhero.id)

     WHERE gender.gender = 'Female' AND publisher.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') AS percent_female_heroes_published_by_marvel_comics

FROM

JOIN

WHERE 
    b.bond_type = '='
